description: Fork of exp664 (1.4630 @ 86.5M). Single change in out_proj: NAP 6 -> 8, tph 256 -> 64 (param-matched). out_proj per layer: 6*64*256*64 = 6,291,456 (= exp664). Total ~86.5M unchanged. Trades 4x more tables (NAP=6 tph=256: 1536 tables) for 4x deeper addressing (NAP=8 tph=64: 384 tables × K=256). Bandwidth REDUCES 4x on out_proj (96 KB/layer vs 384 KB) -> total LUT bandwidth ~2.79 MB/token (was 4.50). Risk: row-collapse — at K=256, each row sees ~32 visits/step (vs 128 at NAP=6, K=64), 4x sparser per-row gradient. Mitigated by hybrid_smooth dense input-grad. Reference: exp664 = 1.4630 (must beat or match for win); underperforming = row-collapse dominates; matching = NAP-vs-tph is neutral; beating = deeper addressing wins at fixed params/budget.
